verdict.rationale: The quick-start documents a CLI scaffold command (`apify create my-first-actor`) that lets a developer start a new Actor project right away, which is a first-party starting point. The evidence never describes a selectable library of multiple ready-made templates. The Store's ready-made Actors and the Docker base images are a different capability and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a template library (multiple language/framework starters), template selection or browsing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building immediately using a library of ready-made project templates
